origin_source: Gangotri Glacier near Gaumukh (as Bhagirathi), Uttarkashi district, Uttarakhand (elevation approx 3,892 m)
basin_states: Uttarakhand, Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, West Bengal, Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan, Haryana, Himachal Pradesh, Chhattisgarh
left_bank_tributaries: Ramganga, Gomti, Ghaghara, Gandak, Kosi, Mahananda
right_bank_tributaries: Yamuna, Son, Punpun, Damodar (distributary Hugli basin)
major_dams_and_projects: Tehri Dam (on Bhagirathi), Farakka Barrage, Haridwar Bhimgoda Barrage, Kanpur Barrage
national_parks_and_protected_areas_cross: Gangotri National Park, Rajaji National Park, Vikramshila Gangetic Dolphin Sanctuary, Sundarbans National Park
interstate_water_disputes: Ganga Water Treaty (1996 international dispute with Bangladesh); domestic tributary water tribunals
cultural_and_economic_significance: Lifeblood of the Indo-Gangetic Plains supporting over 400 million people, vast alluvial agrarian base, sacred pilgrimage centers

origin_source: Trimbakeshwar, Brahmagiri Hills, Nashik district, Maharashtra (elevation approx 1,067 m)
basin_states: Maharashtra, Telangana, Andhra Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Odisha, Madhya Pradesh, Karnataka, Puducherry (Yanam)
left_bank_tributaries: Dharna, Penganga, Wainganga, Wardha, Pranhita, Pench, Kanhan, Indravati, Sabari
major_dams_and_projects: Polavaram National Project, Kaleshwaram Lift Irrigation, Sriram Sagar Project (Pochampad), Jayakwadi Dam
national_parks_and_protected_areas_cross: Indravati National Park, Papikonda National Park, Kanger Ghati National Park, Kinnerasani Wildlife Sanctuary
interstate_water_disputes: Godavari Water Disputes Tribunal (GWDT) between Maharashtra, Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Karnataka, and Odisha
cultural_and_economic_significance: Second longest river in India, sustains the fertile KG agricultural basin and offshore hydrocarbon gas reserves

origin_source: Chemayungdung Glacier near Mount Kailash and Lake Manasarovar, Tibet (known as Yarlung Tsangpo; elevation 5,150 m)
basin_states: Arunachal Pradesh, Assam, West Bengal, Meghalaya, Nagaland, Sikkim
left_bank_tributaries: Lhasa, Nyang, Dibang, Lohit, Burhi Dihing, Dhansiri (South)
right_bank_tributaries: Kameng, Manas, Beki, Raidak, Jaldhaka, Teesta, Subansiri
major_dams_and_projects: Bogibeel Rail-Road Bridge, Dhola-Sadiya Bridge, Subansiri Lower Hydroelectric Project, Ranganadi Dam
national_parks_and_protected_areas_cross: Kaziranga National Park, Manas National Park, Dibru-Saikhowa National Park, Orang National Park
interstate_water_disputes: Transboundary riparian data sharing concerns with China; Teesta water distribution negotiations with Bangladesh
cultural_and_economic_significance: Braided river system hosting Majuli (world's largest inhabited riverine island), major waterway (National Waterway 2)

origin_source: Amarkantak Plateau, Anuppur district, Madhya Pradesh (elevation approx 1,057 m)
basin_states: Madhya Pradesh, Gujarat, Maharashtra, Rajasthan (irrigation beneficiary)
left_bank_tributaries: Sher, Shakkar, Dudhi, Tawa, Ganjal, Chhota Tawa, Kundi
right_bank_tributaries: Hiran, Barna, Choral, Man, Uri, Hatni, Orsang
major_dams_and_projects: Sardar Sarovar Dam, Indira Sagar Project, Omkareshwar Dam, Bargi Dam, Maheshwar Dam
national_parks_and_protected_areas_cross: Kanha National Park (catchment), Satpura National Park, Narmada Canal corridors, Shoolpaneshwar Wildlife Sanctuary
interstate_water_disputes: Narmada Water Disputes Tribunal (NWDT) between Gujarat, Madhya Pradesh, Maharashtra, and Rajasthan
cultural_and_economic_significance: Largest west-flowing river flowing through a fault/rift valley between Vindhya and Satpura ranges; forms Marble Rocks at Bhedaghat

origin_source: Talakaveri in Brahmagiri range, Kodagu (Coorg) district, Karnataka (elevation approx 1,341 m)
right_bank_tributaries: Lakshmantirtha, Kabbani, Suvarnavathi, Bhavani, Noyyal, Amaravati
major_dams_and_projects: Krishna Raja Sagara (KRS) Dam, Mettur Dam (Stanley Reservoir), Shivanasamudra Falls HEP, Grand Anicut (Kallanai)
national_parks_and_protected_areas_cross: Bandipur National Park, Nagarhole National Park (catchment), Cauvery Wildlife Sanctuary, Mudumalai corridor
interstate_water_disputes: Cauvery Water Disputes Tribunal (CWDT) & Cauvery Water Management Authority (CWMA) between TN, KA, KL, and Puducherry
cultural_and_economic_significance: Known as the 'Garden of Southern India'; perennial character due to receiving rain from both Southwest and Northeast monsoons
